archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY (Trust, Growth, Calm) blended with SWISS / DENSE DASHBOARD clarity

brand.name: Mon Atelier Sophto
brand.location: Itinérante dans un rayon de 20 km autour d'Arguenos (31160)

entry_surfaces./: landing page — warm sage/cream organic sophrology portal with public booking modal/section
entry_surfaces./admin/login: branded split login — deep forest green branding & values panel left, clean sage-tinted password auth form right
entry_surfaces./admin: dashboard overview — dense summary stat cards top, pending booking action queue left, quick calendar & services snapshot right
entry_surfaces./admin/rendez-vous: split appointments view — interactive requests queue with confirm/refuse actions top, configurable booking rules & working hours drawer right
entry_surfaces./admin/calendar: full administrative schedule — day/week/month interactive view with status-colored appointment blocks and slot details modal
entry_surfaces./admin/services: services catalog management — structured pricing and duration table with modal for service creation/edition
entry_surfaces./admin/clients: client directory — dense searchable table with contact records, booking history count, and direct note view
entry_surfaces./admin/parametres: profile & atelier settings — practitioner details, avatar photo upload with instant preview, zone radius configuration

dashboard_grid.stats_row: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6

calendar_grid.header_controls: flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 mb-4
calendar_grid.view_container: bg-white rounded-xl border border-[#E4DDD3] p-4 shadow-sm

motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-150 ease-out, transition-opacity duration-150 ease-out, transition-transform duration-200 ease-out

accessibility.standards: WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 contrast for all text)
accessibility.data_testids: Mandatory data-testid on every button, input, link, tab, select, and status badge
accessibility.aria_labels: Clear aria-label on icon-only buttons (collapse sidebar, close modal, edit/delete actions)

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain the exact organic sage, warm beige, forest green, and terracotta palette for both landing and admin back-office.

Implement real password login for admin (default admin password can be e.g. 'sophro2026' or configured in database/env). Store session token in localStorage or cookie, redirecting unauthenticated users from /admin to /admin/login.

The admin back-office must include all required pages: /admin (Dashboard with stats + pending requests list), /admin/rendez-vous (Appointments with confirm/refuse buttons + Booking Settings drawer/panel), /admin/calendar (Day, Week, Month views of scheduled sessions), /admin/services (CRUD for sophrology sessions with name, duration, price, description), /admin/clients (Clients list with history and contact info), /admin/parametres (Profile management, bio, location, working zone, profile photo upload with preview).
Public booking form on landing page must submit real appointment requests into MongoDB with status 'pending' (en attente). Admin can then confirm (confirmé) or refuse (refusé).
Booking settings must allow configuring: open days (Lundi to Dimanche toggles), working hours (start/end times), gap between appointments (0min, 15min, 30min, 1h), and max appointments per day.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='admin-login-submit', data-testid='appointment-confirm-btn', data-testid='calendar-view-toggle', etc.).
Use French language throughout the whole application.
